snippet_primary: "If you live in one of the following direct-deposit countries, Gumroad pays you out in your native currency. All currency conversions happen based on the exchange rates at the time of sale, not at the time of the payout. These are typically mid-market rates that you can estimate here."
subject_exact: payouts in native currency for direct-deposit countries, with all conversions at typically mid-market exchange rates from the time of sale, not payout
